operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm check:deployment-spec && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party
operations.recovery: Follow docs/backup.md and OPERATIONS.md. Pause writes and scheduled work, export the local installation with rer export or the hosted installation with pnpm backup:hosted, retain exact source and private settings, restore into fresh empty resources, re-export and compare data and attachment bytes before routing traffic. Preserve every applied migration name and byte.
